levels.label: 入门
levels.description: 认识日常物品和常见网页按钮，读懂简短表达。

levels.label: 基础
levels.description: 掌握出行、购物和应用操作，练习常见请求。

levels.label: 进阶
levels.description: 交流偏好与需求，处理生活安排和上网问题。

levels.label: 挑战
levels.description: 理解较长说明，清楚表达条件、原因和解决办法。

items.example_zh: 更改预订的截止时间是周五。

items.example: You need to pay a deposit to rent the bike.
items.example_zh: 租这辆自行车需要支付押金。

items.example: The lift is closed for maintenance this morning.
items.example_zh: 电梯今天上午因维护暂停使用。

items.example: Could you explain the procedure for returning an item?
items.example_zh: 你能解释一下退货流程吗？

items.example: A ticket is the only requirement for entry.
items.example_zh: 入场只要求有一张票。

items.example: Can you make an exception just this once?
items.example_zh: 你能就这一次破个例吗？

items.example: Can the restaurant accommodate a group of eight?
items.example_zh: 这家餐厅能接待八人一组的客人吗？

items.example: Keep the receipt if you want reimbursement for the taxi fare.
items.example_zh: 如果想报销出租车费，请保留小票。

items.example: The guide helps you troubleshoot connection problems.
items.example_zh: 这份指南帮助你排查并解决连接问题。

items.example: Video calls require more bandwidth than text messages.
items.example_zh: 视频通话需要的带宽比文字消息更多。

items.example: High latency makes online games feel slow.
items.example_zh: 高延迟会让在线游戏感觉反应很慢。

items.example: Check compatibility before installing the app.
items.example_zh: 安装应用前先检查兼容性。

items.example: My subscription includes offline downloads.
items.example_zh: 我的订阅服务包含离线下载功能。

items.example: You can turn off automatic renewal in your account settings.
items.example_zh: 你可以在账户设置中关闭自动续订。

items.example: The free trial lasts for seven days.
items.example_zh: 免费试用期为七天。

items.example: The premium version removes ads.
items.example_zh: 付费升级版会移除广告。

items.example: Check the coupon's expiration date before using it.
items.example_zh: 使用优惠券前先查看到期日期。

items.example: The transaction appears in your payment history.
items.example_zh: 这笔交易会显示在你的付款记录中。

items.example: You should receive an order confirmation by email.
items.example_zh: 你应该会通过电子邮件收到订单确认信息。

items.example: Check the source before judging the article's credibility.
items.example_zh: 判断文章的可信度之前，先查看来源。

items.example: The title is misleading because it leaves out key details.
items.example_zh: 这个标题遗漏了关键细节，具有误导性。

items.example: Use specific words to find more relevant search results.
items.example_zh: 使用具体的词语来找到更相关的搜索结果。

items.example: The team used our feedback to improve the app.
items.example_zh: 团队根据我们的反馈改进了应用。

items.example: You can hide a recommendation you are not interested in.
items.example_zh: 你可以隐藏不感兴趣的推荐内容。

items.example: The algorithm suggests videos based on what you watch.
items.example_zh: 算法会根据你观看的内容推荐视频。

items.example: Choose a lower resolution to use less mobile data.
items.example_zh: 选择较低的分辨率以减少移动数据流量消耗。

items.example: Turn on captions to follow the video more easily.
items.example_zh: 打开字幕，更容易听懂视频内容。

items.example: Larger text can improve accessibility for many users.
items.example_zh: 更大的文字能让许多用户更方便地使用。

items.example: The app uses fingerprint authentication to sign you in.
items.example_zh: 这个应用通过指纹身份验证让你登录。

items.example: Enter the verification code sent to your phone.
items.example_zh: 输入发送到你手机上的验证码。

items.example: The app asks for your consent before sharing usage data.
items.example_zh: 这个应用在分享使用数据前会征求你的同意。

items.example: You can archive old messages instead of deleting them.
items.example_zh: 你可以把旧消息归档，而不是删除。

items.example: Click the link at the bottom to unsubscribe from these emails.
items.example_zh: 点击底部的链接，取消订阅这些邮件。

items.english: Would you mind letting me know if an earlier appointment becomes available?
items.chinese: 如果有更早的预约时段空出来，能请你通知我吗？

items.english: I may need to reschedule, depending on when the repair is finished.
items.chinese: 我可能需要重新安排时间，要看维修什么时候完成。

items.english: Could you clarify whether the price includes delivery?
items.chinese: 你能说明一下这个价格是否包含配送费用吗？

items.english: I would appreciate it if you could confirm the details in writing.
items.chinese: 如果你能以书面形式确认这些细节，我会很感激。

items.english: As long as we leave before rush hour, we should arrive on time.
items.chinese: 只要我们在高峰时段之前出发，应该就能准时到达。

items.english: Rather than cancel the trip, we could choose a closer destination.
items.chinese: 我们可以选个近一点的目的地，而不必取消旅行。

items.english: I understand the policy, but is there any flexibility in this situation?
items.chinese: 我理解这项规定，但这种情况能否灵活处理？

items.english: Let me know what works for you, and I will adjust my schedule.
items.chinese: 告诉我你方便的时间，我会调整自己的日程。

items.english: If I had known the shop closed early, I would have gone in the morning.
items.chinese: 如果我早知道店铺提前关门，就会上午过去。

items.english: Before we make a decision, could we compare the total costs?
items.chinese: 做决定之前，我们能比较一下总费用吗？

items.english: The sooner we confirm the booking, the more options we will have.
items.chinese: 越早确认预订，我们能选择的方案就越多。

items.english: I was wondering whether you could accommodate one more person.
items.chinese: 我想问一下，你们能否再接待一位客人。

items.english: Thank you for being so patient while we worked out the details.
items.chinese: 谢谢你在我们商量细节的时候这么耐心。

items.english: Before the trial ends, check whether the subscription renews automatically.
items.chinese: 试用结束前，检查订阅是否会自动续费。

items.english: The app worked fine until the latest update, which changed some settings.
items.chinese: 应用原本运行正常，但最近的更新更改了一些设置。

items.english: Could you walk me through the steps without assuming I know the technical terms?
items.chinese: 你能一步步教我操作，把我当作不懂技术术语的人来讲吗？

items.english: If the issue continues after restarting, send the error details to support.
items.chinese: 如果重启后问题依然存在，把错误详情发给客服。

items.english: I would rather wait for a stable version than install one that may crash.
items.chinese: 我宁愿等一个稳定版本，也不想安装可能崩溃的版本。

items.english: Although the title sounds convincing, the article does not provide a source.
items.chinese: 虽然标题听起来很有说服力，但文章没有提供来源。

items.english: You can decline optional permissions and still use the main features.
items.chinese: 你可以拒绝可选权限，仍然使用主要功能。

items.english: The lower the video resolution, the less bandwidth it usually requires.
items.chinese: 视频分辨率越低，通常需要的带宽就越少。

items.english: Could you confirm whether my cancellation has been processed?
items.chinese: 你能确认一下我的取消申请是否已经处理吗？

items.english: Please include the app version and the steps that led to the error.
items.chinese: 请附上应用版本以及导致错误的操作步骤。

items.english: I might be missing something, but I cannot find the option mentioned in the guide.
items.chinese: 可能是我漏看了什么，但我找不到指南中提到的选项。

items.english: Once you have backed up your files, you can safely reinstall the app.
items.chinese: 备份好文件以后，你就可以放心重装应用了。
